name: Republic of Acre (1903)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, yellow above and green below, with a red five-pointed star in the upper hoist.
history: Plácido de Castro's third Republic of Acre, proclaimed on 27 January 1903 after the Acrean revolution against Bolivia, used Gálvez's bicolour with the red star credited to Rodrigo de Carvalho; the star had been readopted on 7 August 1902 at the start of the revolt. The republic ended with the Treaty of Petrópolis of 17 November 1903, which ceded Acre to Brazil, and the flag became that of the Brazilian territory and state.

features.symbolism: the blood shed in the Acrean revolution
